manaNeeded: {U/P} if the creature with Freed from the Real attached is not blue
notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to a creature without summmoning sickness that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
If the creature with Freed from the Real attached is not blue, activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing the creature to become a blue artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2.
